collection.name: Bitshaders
collection.description:
Bitshaders is a Bitcoin-native Ordinals collection that reveals the hidden personas behind crypto culture.

Each Bitshader is a 3D digital archetype, a character inspired by the real people who shape the Bitcoin ecosystem. From coders and maximalists to manipulators and whisperers, Bitshaders captures the raw, unfiltered spirit of Bitcoin.

This is more than a PFP project. It's a tribute to the minds behind the wallets.
Minted on Bitcoin. Forged in narrative. Built for those who see beyond the chart.
